正文引用 [^1] [^2] [^3]。This is a footnote [^4] in English.

[^1]: [1] 角标引用
[^2]: 这是中文开头的脚注。
[^3]: 这是一个非常长的脚注，包含了很多内容，甚至可以换行。它的长度和基线都和正文对齐，而不是像上标一样悬浮在上面。
[^4]: This is a footnote in English. It is long enough to wrap to the next line, and its number is set at the note body's size and baseline, instead of floating above it as a superscript.
